title: Middle Eastern Harees
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish made with wheat and meat, slow-cooked to perfection.
instructions: Rinse the barley and soak it in water for at least 8 hours.
In a large pot, brown the lamb or beef over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened.
Add the soaked barley, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Pour in the water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2-3 hours.
Serve the harees hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
